answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the oasis queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 633 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the karst. The mirror index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Honest users pay that once, farms 19 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
